description:
Equanimity Essence is a structured lifestyle brand offering curated jewellery, apparel, watches, footwear, and bags designed around clarity, balance, and long-term wear. Our collections prioritise material integrity, refined proportions, and practical elegance. We focus on sustainable growth and consistent brand positioning, offering affiliates a clean commission structure and controlled promotional environment.

We partner with content creators, stylists, publishers, and performance partners who value real world wearability, thoughtful design, and authentic presentation. Our affiliate program supports brand aligned promotion across editorial, search, and discovery channels within clearly defined guidelines.
payout_period: Payouts are processed monthly on the 1st, following a 30-day holding period to account for order confirmation and returns.
term_and_condition:
AFFILIATE PROGRAM TERMS

These Affiliate Program Terms apply to all applicants and approved participants in the Equanimity Essence affiliate program (the “Program”). By submitting an application or participating in the Program, you agree to these terms in addition to the Equanimity Essence website Terms and Privacy Policy.

1. Application and Approval

Participation in the Program is by application only. All applications are reviewed manually, and approval is granted at our sole discretion. Submission of an application does not guarantee acceptance. We may decline or revoke participation at any time, without obligation to provide reasons.

2. Affiliate Relationship

Approved affiliates may promote Equanimity Essence using a unique referral link provided through the Program. This relationship does not create any partnership, joint venture, agency, employment, or representative relationship between you and Equanimity Essence.

3. Commission Eligibility

Commissions are earned on qualifying purchases that are correctly tracked through your referral link within the applicable attribution window. Attribution is determined on a last-click basis within the defined tracking window. Affiliates may not earn commission on purchases made by themselves, immediate family members, or controlled entities. Commissions may be reversed or withheld in cases including, but not limited to, product returns, cancellations, refunds, chargebacks, fraudulent activity, or breaches of these terms.

4. Approved Promotion Methods

Affiliates may promote Equanimity Essence via content, editorial, search, email marketing, comparison platforms, and coupon or deal websites, provided all activity complies with these Terms and applicable laws.

The following are not permitted:

• Brand keyword bidding (including variations or misspellings)
• Paid advertising using our brand name without written approval
• Misleading, deceptive, or inaccurate representations
• Unauthorized trademark use
• Browser extensions, toolbar applications, automatic coupon injection, cookie stuffing, or traffic redirection tools
• Purchased, scraped, or non-permission-based email lists

We reserve the right to determine whether promotion methods are compliant.

5. Payments

Commission payments are processed via the available payout methods in accordance with the Program’s payout schedule and minimum threshold (currently USD $20, subject to change). Affiliates are responsible for any taxes, fees, or reporting obligations arising from payments received.

6. Termination

We may suspend or terminate your participation in the Program at any time, with or without notice. Upon termination, any unpaid commissions that are not yet eligible for payout, or that relate to non-compliant activity, may be forfeited.

7. Modifications

We may update or modify these Affiliate Program Terms from time to time. Continued participation in the Program after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

8. Governing Law

These Affiliate Program Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of New South Wales, Australia.

9. Privacy

Personal data collected in connection with the Program is handled in accordance with the Equanimity Essence Privacy Policy.
